name: agent-activity-dashboard
description: Real-time local dashboard of Claude Code agent activity (OTel + hooks)

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace server && npm run build --workspace ui
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace server && npm run build --workspace ui && npm run test:brain-ui && npm run test:brain-launcher
scripts.test:brain-ui: tsx --tsconfig ui/tsconfig.json --test scripts/brain-reader.test.tsx scripts/brain-graph.test.ts scripts/brain-memory-ui.test.tsx scripts/brain-analysis-ui.test.tsx scripts/brain-analysis-polling.test.tsx
scripts.format:brain: prettier --write "server/src/brain*.ts" "server/src/brain/**/*.ts" "ui/src/components/Brain*.*" "ui/src/components/brain/**/*.{ts,tsx,css}" "scripts/brain-*.*" scripts/start-brain.mjs ui/src/App.tsx "server/prompts/*.md" BRAIN-AGENTS.md COGNEE.md BRAIN-NOTION-COGNEE-PLAN.md AGENTS.md server/src/brain/config.json package.json .prettierrc.json NOTION-MCP.md
scripts.format:brain:check: prettier --check "server/src/brain*.ts" "server/src/brain/**/*.ts" "ui/src/components/Brain*.*" "ui/src/components/brain/**/*.{ts,tsx,css}" "scripts/brain-*.*" scripts/start-brain.mjs ui/src/App.tsx "server/prompts/*.md" BRAIN-AGENTS.md COGNEE.md BRAIN-NOTION-COGNEE-PLAN.md AGENTS.md server/src/brain/config.json package.json .prettierrc.json NOTION-MCP.md
scripts.test:brain-notion: npm run build --workspace server && node --test server/dist/brain-notion.test.js
